description: This file defines an AuthApi class that provides methods to interact with authentication-related FastAPI endpoints, including login, signup, OTP verification, token refresh, and password reset. It manages HTTP requests and response handling for the authentication flow.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: A client class to interact with authentication-related API endpoints, managing login, signup, OTP, token refresh, and password resets with built-in handling for auth token refresh.

methods.name: AuthApi
methods.description: Constructor allowing optional setting of base URL for API endpoints.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Builds a Uri object from the base URL and given path.

methods.name: _jsonHeaders
methods.description: Generates HTTP headers for JSON content, optionally including a Bearer token.

methods.name: _handleJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes HTTP responses, validates status codes, decodes JSON, and throws exceptions on errors.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Internal method to send POST requests with JSON body and handle responses.

methods.name: postJsonWithAuth
methods.description: Performs a POST request with authorization, handles token expiration by refreshing token once if needed.

methods.name: loginWithPassword
methods.description: Sends login request with phone/email and password.

methods.name: requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for login/signup, optionally with purpose.

methods.name: signupWithPassword
methods.description: Signs up a new user with phone, email, password, optional name, and consent.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates a password reset process for a given phone or email.

methods.name: passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Completes password reset with OTP and new password.
